notes: Daughter of Dan and Gertrude (Simons) Groves.

Born 18 Oct 1909; died 11 Aug 1999 (Find a Grave and the Social Security Death Index; the Oregon death index gives 11 Jun 1999 in Multnomah County). Married Benjamin Sebastian Sawyer Jr. in 1929; their son Benjamin III was born in Seattle in 1931 and raised in Portland.
